mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user_company` (`user_id`, `company_id`, `company_role`, `status`, `joined_at`) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyId}, #{companyRole}, 1, NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `company_role` = new.`company_role`, `status` = 1, `leave_type` = NULL, `joined_at` = new.`joined_at`, `left_at` = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.`id` AS userId, u.`nickname`, u.`phone`, u.`avatar_key` AS avatarKey, uc.`company_role` AS companyRole, uc.`joined_at` AS joinedAt FROM `user_company` uc JOIN `user` u ON u.`id` = uc.`user_id` WHERE uc.`company_id` = #{companyId} AND uc.`status` = 1 ORDER BY FIELD(uc.`company_role`, 'FOUNDER', 'MANAGER', 'EMPLOYEE'), uc.`joined_at`
mapper.update: UPDATE `user_company` SET `status` = 0, `leave_type` = 2, `left_at` = NOW() WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `company_id` = #{companyId} AND `status` = 1
UPDATE `user_company` SET `status` = 0, `leave_type` = 3, `left_at` = NOW() WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `company_id` = #{companyId} AND `status` = 1
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `user_company` WHERE `company_id` = #{companyId} AND `status` = 1 AND `company_role` = 'MANAGER' )
